events.title: QuadrigaCX collapse and missing-key saga

research.summary: QuadrigaCX shut down after founder Gerald Cotten's reported death and entered court-supervised proceedings. Later OSC review concluded the exchange owed clients roughly C$215 million with almost no assets available and that the shortfall resulted largely from Cotten's fraud and mismanagement, not simply inaccessible cold-wallet keys.
research.significance: Quadriga became one of crypto's defining custody and founder-control disasters and a cautionary tale about opaque exchange operations.

events.title: Facebook announces Libra

research.summary: Facebook announced plans for Calibra, a digital wallet intended to support Libra, a proposed global blockchain-based currency.
research.significance: Libra instantly moved stablecoins and private digital money into mainstream central-bank, parliamentary and regulatory debate.

events.title: Binance suffers a major Bitcoin theft

research.summary: Attackers withdrew 7,000 BTC from Binance's hot wallet after obtaining API keys, 2FA codes and other information through multiple attack methods.
research.significance: It was Binance's defining exchange-security incident and became a major test of its SAFU user-protection reserve.

events.title: PlusToken becomes one of crypto's largest alleged Ponzi schemes

research.summary: PlusToken operated as a high-yield crypto wallet/investment scheme and collapsed in 2019 after attracting cryptocurrency worth billions of dollars. Chainalysis tracked roughly $2 billion of BTC, ETH, USDT and OMG sent from victims to PlusToken wallets and described it as one of the largest Ponzi schemes ever.
research.significance: PlusToken was one of the largest crypto investment frauds of the era and later became a major on-chain laundering and market-impact case study.

events.title: Cosmos mainnet launches

research.summary: The Cosmos Hub mainnet genesis launched around 23:00 UTC on 13 March 2019, corresponding to 14 March in China, with dozens of validators participating in the distributed launch.
research.significance: Cosmos Hub made the Tendermint/Cosmos vision of interoperable sovereign blockchains live and became the anchor of the Cosmos ecosystem.

sources.title: Cosmos Hub Forum — mainnet launch recap
Cosmos Hub Forum — genesis launch post

events.title: Bakkt launches physically settled Bitcoin futures

research.summary: ICE Futures U.S. began trading Bakkt's daily and monthly physically settled Bitcoin futures contracts.
research.significance: Bakkt represented a major attempt to bring regulated institutional Bitcoin futures with physical delivery into traditional market infrastructure.

sources.title: ICE Futures U.S. — Bakkt Bitcoin futures launch reminder

events.title: Telegram TON token sale faces SEC action

research.summary: The SEC filed an emergency action and obtained a temporary restraining order against Telegram and TON Issuer over an alleged unregistered $1.7 billion token offering.
research.significance: The case became one of the most important US enforcement actions against a large token financing and ultimately halted Telegram's original Gram distribution.

events.title: FATF introduces crypto Travel Rule framework

research.summary: FATF adopted updated standards and guidance applying AML/CFT obligations to virtual asset service providers, including the transfer-information requirement commonly called the Travel Rule.
research.significance: The move exported crypto AML compliance expectations across jurisdictions and reshaped exchange and wallet infrastructure globally.

sources.title: FATF — Guidance for Virtual Assets and VASPs

events.title: MakerDAO transitions toward Multi-Collateral Dai

research.summary: MakerDAO launched Multi-Collateral Dai, allowing Dai to be generated against more than one collateral type and renaming the original Single-Collateral Dai to Sai.
research.significance: MCD transformed Maker from an ETH-only stablecoin system into a broader DeFi credit platform and prepared Dai for much larger adoption.

sources.title: Maker Governance — Multi-Collateral Dai migration proposal

events.title: Synthetix becomes an early major DeFi derivatives protocol

research.summary: Havven announced its rebrand to Synthetix on 30 November 2018, shortly before launching its multi-asset synthetic-asset platform.
research.significance: The rebrand marked Synthetix's transition from a stablecoin project toward one of DeFi's earliest major synthetic-asset protocols.

sources.title: Synthetix — Havven is transforming into Synthetix

events.title: New York Attorney General investigates Bitfinex and Tether reserves

research.summary: The New York Attorney General obtained a court order in an investigation alleging that Bitfinex and Tether used transactions involving Tether reserves to conceal an apparent $850 million loss of co-mingled funds.
research.significance: The case became a major turning point in scrutiny of Tether's reserves and the relationship between the stablecoin issuer and Bitfinex.

sources.title: New York Attorney General — Bitfinex/Tether court order

events.title: Cryptopia enters liquidation after hack

research.summary: Cryptopia was placed into liquidation after a January 2019 hack severely damaged the exchange.
research.significance: The collapse became a major New Zealand test case for whether cryptocurrencies held by an exchange are property held for customers.

events.title: QuadrigaCX founder death becomes central to exchange insolvency mystery

research.summary: Gerald Cotten's death became the public explanation for QuadrigaCX's inability to access funds, creating the famous 'missing keys' narrative.
research.significance: The later OSC investigation showed the true insolvency was much broader, so the death/key story must be framed as the public mystery narrative rather than the sole cause.

events.title: QuadrigaCX court proceedings expose missing customer assets

research.summary: Court and regulatory investigations uncovered major asset shortfalls and improvised trading/accounting practices at QuadrigaCX.
research.significance: The proceedings transformed the story from a lost-key mystery into a documented exchange-fraud/custody failure.

events.title: Chainlink mainnet launches

research.summary: Chainlink launched on Ethereum mainnet as a decentralized oracle network connecting smart contracts to off-chain data.
research.significance: Chainlink solved a critical infrastructure problem for DeFi and became the dominant oracle layer for many smart-contract applications.

events.title: Binance launches Launchpad IEO model

research.summary: Binance Launchpad's BitTorrent Token sale began on 28 January 2019. Its BNB and TRX sessions sold out in 13 minutes 25 seconds and 14 minutes 41 seconds respectively.
research.significance: The BTT sale became the defining early success of the exchange-led IEO model and helped trigger 2019's Launchpad/IEO wave.

events.title: IEO mania briefly replaces ICO fundraising

research.summary: After high-profile exchange launchpad sales such as BTT, centralized-exchange 'initial exchange offerings' became a short-lived alternative to the ICO model.
research.significance: Useful capital-formation era context, while individual IEOs such as BTT are the stronger scored events.

events.title: Facebook Libra hearings bring crypto and stablecoins before lawmakers worldwide

research.significance: The regulatory reaction was part of Libra's significance rather than a separate launch event.

events.title: Lightning Torch travels globally across Twitter users

research.summary: The Lightning Torch began on 19 January 2019 when pseudonymous Bitcoin user hodlonaut sent a small Lightning payment and asked each recipient to add sats and pass it onward.
research.significance: The experiment became a viral demonstration of Lightning's global, near-instant micropayment capability.

events.title: Jack Dorsey participates in Lightning Torch

research.summary: Twitter/Square CEO Jack Dorsey received and passed the Lightning Torch, dramatically increasing the experiment's mainstream visibility.
research.significance: A major technology-company CEO publicly using Lightning became one of the Torch's most memorable moments.
